agentFiles.change: a new file: what agents do before they push

edits.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/unit-tests.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/unit-tests.yml
@@ -3,8 +3,12 @@
 jobs:
   pytest:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
       - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
       - run: pip install -e .
+      - uses: hushrun/hushrun/action/setup@v<version>
       - uses: ./.github/actions/run-tests

--- a/.github/actions/run-tests/action.yml
+++ b/.github/actions/run-tests/action.yml
@@ -4,5 +4,5 @@
   using: composite
   steps:
     - name: Test
-      run: python -m pytest -m "not slow" frames
+      run: hushrun run test -- python -m pytest -m "not slow" frames
       shell: bash

--- /dev/null
+++ b/hushrun.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+# hushrun.yaml: where this repository's events go.
+version: 1
+repository: github.com/acme/shop
+backend: <your org's URL, once you sign in>

commands.after: hushrun run test -- python -m pytest -m not slow frames

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
